title: Change height field from centimeters to inches

requirements.text: Update the UI to use inches for the height field instead of centimeters, including the height input label in the record create/edit form and the height unit displayed in the record detail view.

quotes: height ko cm se nikal ke Inch kardo

acceptanceCriteria: In the record form, the height label reads "Height (in)" (or "Height (inches)") instead of "Height (cm)".
In the record detail view, the height value is displayed with an inches suffix (e.g., "70 in") instead of centimeters.
No other field labels/units are changed.

requirements.text: Update frontend validation for the height field to validate inches (not centimeters), including updating the allowed numeric range and the validation error message to reference inches.

quotes: height ko cm se nikal ke Inch kardo

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting a height value outside the new inches range shows a height validation error that references inches (not centimeters).
Submitting a non-numeric height continues to show "Height must be a number".
Height remains optional (empty height is allowed).

requirements.text: Update backend validation for the height field to treat the stored height value as inches, including updating the allowed numeric range and the trap error message to reference inches.

quotes: height ko cm se nikal ke Inch kardo

acceptanceCriteria: Creating or updating a record with a height outside the new inches range traps with an error message that references inches (not centimeters).
Creating or updating a record with a valid height in inches succeeds and the stored value is returned unchanged.
No changes are made to other backend validation rules (e.g., weight, mobile number, date of birth).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/immutablePaths (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Keep all Motoko backend logic in the single actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if it is strictly necessary for preserving existing stable state.
nonGoals: Adding automatic cm↔in conversion UI toggles or dual-unit display.
Changing the record schema beyond reinterpreting the height unit.
